title: AI agents and memory costs are reshaping where and how we sell
summary: Asus expects the 2027 PC market to shrink 10-15% on memory prices; tablet shipments fell 23% in Q3 (Omdia). Amazon took Alexa shopping to 15 countries; OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet. Amex sees 14-year-high small business holiday spending.

points.headline: Memory prices threaten a smaller 2027 PC market and tighter tablet supply
points.detail: Asus expects the PC market to shrink 10-15% in 2027; tablet shipments fell 23% in Q3. OEMs are trimming memory orders. We should plan promo depth, mix and stock for higher prices.

points.headline: AI shopping assistants and agent payments are going mainstream
points.detail: Amazon took Alexa for Shopping to 15 countries and OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet for agent checkout. Our store and product data should be ready for agent-led discovery and orders.

points.headline: Amazon and JD.com are consolidating electronics discovery
points.detail: Amazon plans to catalog every product, and JD.com seeks to lead European electronics retail via Ceconomy. We need accurate listings and a plan for shifting channel terms.

points.headline: Small businesses are spending more this holiday season
points.detail: Amex projects a 14-year high in small business holiday spending. We should push business bundles, financing and bulk offers now.
